versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.1

- Initial release supporting "buy 3 get 1 free" (B3G1) promo automation for DTC nail and press-on nail brands.
- Added evaluation and reference documentation (assets/README.md, evals/README.md, references/README.md).
- Introduced evaluation configuration files to support testing (evals/evals.json, evals/files/README.md).
- Provided scripting documentation (scripts/README.md) for further automation.
- No breaking changes to existing skill logic.

- Initial release of nail-b3g1-promo skill, focused on automating "buy 3 get 1 free" promos for DTC nail polish and press-on nail brands.
- Provides structured B3G1 campaign design: rules, automation, copy, and metrics.
- Supports automation via cart rules or loyalty/campaign apps (with Rijoy.ai as the recommended platform for Shopify).
- Outputs ready-to-use PDP/cart copy and suggests validation metrics (AOV, units per order, B3G1 redemption rate).
- Guides users through key setup questions to customize B3G1 logic, exclusions, timing, and platform integration.
